claim: If and only if the final qualification record is PASS and both the specification lock and full qualification lock verify, WP2-MULTIQ-v1 qualifies the declared fixed-energy extended-canonical three-chart, two-spinor KS atlas for the translation-reduced spatial Newtonian three-body problem. The qualified atlas has one T^2 gauge action per chart, one chart-independent Sundman law dt/ds=r12*r23*r31, canonical quotient transitions on collision-free chart overlaps, and smooth fictitious-time continuation through each isolated binary-collision divisor while the third body remains separated.
evidence_boundary: The claim covers positive finite masses, zero Xi levels, three central-body charts, collision-free projection to the qualified Newtonian flow, bounded near-collision trajectories, and local passage through every isolated binary channel. It excludes triple collision, any state with two simultaneous pair collisions, nonzero-Xi magnetic reduction, SO(3) reduction, a single unconstrained 24-dimensional three-pair phase space, arbitrary-duration accuracy, completeness outside the frozen corpus, additional first integrals, Liouville or B-integrability, and every WP3/WP4 claim.

model.physical_space: The 12-dimensional translation quotient at total momentum zero, with canonical inertial momenta p_i=m_i*v_i.
model.chart_coordinates: For local bodies (a,b,c), X1=r_a-r_c and X2=r_b-r_c with canonical W1=p_a and W2=p_b on total momentum zero. Each (Xk,Wk) is lifted by the qualified KS cotangent convention to (qk,Pk).
model.extended_phase_space: T*(R4 x R4 x R), ordered (q1,q2,t,P1,P2,p_t), dimension 18 before constraints.
model.gauge_group: T2=S1xS1 acts independently and cotangently on (q1,P1) and (q2,P2). Xi1=Xi2=0 are first-class momentum-map levels. The quotient has dimension 14 and projects to the physical 12D translation quotient plus (t,p_t).
model.hamiltonian: K=g*(H+p_t)=R3*F-k3*R1*R2, where F=R2*(|P1|^2/(8*mu1)-k1)+R1*(|P2|^2/(8*mu2)-k2)+dot(DK(q1)P1,DK(q2)P2)/(16*m_c)+p_t*R1*R2, mu1=m_a*m_c/(m_a+m_c), mu2=m_b*m_c/(m_b+m_c), k1=G*m_a*m_c, k2=G*m_b*m_c, and k3=G*m_a*m_b.
model.fixed_energy_shell: p_t=-h and K=0. On a collision-free shell the projected field equals g*X_H. At qk=0 with the other two distances nonzero, |Pk|^2=8*mu_k*k_k and the canonical field is finite.
model.transition: Project a zero-Xi state to the physical translation quotient, reconstruct the target chart's two canonical pairs, and apply the target KS cotangent section. Transitions are defined only on collision-free overlaps and preserve t and p_t.
model.switch_policy: Use a chart in which the smallest pair is one of the two KS-regularized edges. Switch only on a collision-free overlap; chart selection never changes g or the physical dynamics.
model.triple_collision_policy: If two pair distances are simultaneously below the frozen collision floor, classify OUT_OF_SCOPE_TRIPLE_COLLISION and do not continue.

corpus.channel_balance: Every split contains all three collision channels; exact-passage cases are balanced 3 per channel over the full corpus.
corpus.holdout_classification: Execution-reserved compositional and collision-passage evidence. Public upstream physical states are not a blind scientific holdout.

execution.independent_reference: A separately encoded JAX x64 scalar Hamiltonian differentiated automatically, plus REBOUND IAS15 physical checkpoints and published Heggie/Aarseth-Zare identities.
execution.holdout_rule: The holdout runner verifies the specification lock and every full-lock file hash, refuses an existing output, and writes the holdout exactly once.

invalidation: Any changed model formula, time law, chart convention, threshold, corpus eligibility rule, code path, source payload, prerequisite record, or post-lock decision input invalidates v1. A failed holdout remains FAIL and requires a new campaign version.
downstream_policy: A PASS authorizes a separately locked WP3 search on this exact multi-chart model. It does not transfer the WP3-UP-v3 null result, authorize a candidate, open a publication reserve, or establish integrability.
